title: The waiting page shows what differs between options, opens the exact state, and takes combined answers
why: Review-page standard from an outside page you shared, Oct 27 02:23 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2DrFwwCVeSEX2GFLj7CxtiZ); the c100 lane left items 2, 3 and 5 out of scope.
note: Build in skills/waiting-page: (2) a coloured edge marks what differs between options; (3) "open this state in the full mockup" deep-links to a named state. Items 1, 4 and 6 landed with c100; item 5 (combined answers) moved to c135. From shiv's page reviews (Oct 27 11:47 CDT degen's page, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2WX6jeX97e4YdP1xjEqUvnJ; 11:56 CDT banchi's, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2ByQ3cy16LrifwTudkSyi83 and cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2MYnDNTawHFW2QEBty1eAzw): each option's picture sits inside its option card, fitted whole (what a tap on it does is d9's, ruled 12:13 CDT); the option chip shows A, B, C on one line and never overlaps the title; "Take my pick" and "Ready to send" name the option's title; the digit in "0 of 9 sent" matches its line; the left list gives each item a short title; the gold star on the pick box becomes the AI sparkle icon (inline SVG). Small c100 review defects: undoSend's bar repeats "and"; a failed Undo names one item; a failed receipt delete can leave an old receipt; empty tiers hide their empty line. Rulings: Oct 27 02:27 CDT (shiv), a question that changes no rule sits in a last "Pick stands" section (on main); Oct 26 (c74), keep "Accept every pick" and list every pick before it saves. Clear and pick-less notes go in the c126/d9 lane. Port: yes.
